description: This file defines command-line interface logic for a 'wizard' feature in the OpenClaw macOS CLI application. It includes parsing command-line options and arguments, establishing a WebSocket connection to a gateway, handling the wizard's interactive workflow, processing different types of wizard steps, and handling responses or errors.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An actor that manages WebSocket communication with the gateway for the wizard protocol, handling connection establishment, message sending/receiving, and authentication.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Entry point for executing the wizard command with arguments. Parses options, initializes connection, and runs the wizard interaction loop.
